lines.zh: 我迈开长腿，慢吞吞地走。
lines.en: I stretch my long legs and walk, slow and loose.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在落叶上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My claws press the leaf litter lightly.

lines.zh: 我低头走过树林，肩膀擦着枝叶。
lines.en: I walk the grove with my shoulders brushing the leaves.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，重心很稳。
lines.en: I walk step by step, well balanced.

lines.zh: 我抬起前肢，够到高处的叶。
lines.en: I raise a forelimb to reach high leaves.

lines.zh: 我把一根低枝拽下来，边走边吃。
lines.en: I pull a low branch down and eat as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走过溪边，低头看了看水。
lines.en: I pass the stream and look down at the water.
I step around a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子在树影里一晃一晃。
lines.en: My long neck sways through the shade.

lines.zh: 我转身时，尾巴扫了一下草。
lines.en: Turning, my tail sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 我朝林子深处走，慢慢找。
lines.en: I head deeper into the trees, searching.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头上跨过去。
lines.en: I step over a stone.

lines.zh: 我站在树下，慢慢嚼叶子。
lines.en: I stand under a tree, chewing leaves.
I lift a forepaw and hold it there.

lines.zh: 我歪头看树冠上的一片叶。
lines.en: I tilt my head at a leaf in the canopy.
I stretch my neck toward the water.
I shake off the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我把抬起的前爪缓缓放稳。
lines.en: I lower the raised foreclaw slowly and steady it.
I listen to the birds in the grove.
I bring my head close to a trunk.
I stand still, like a piece of the tree.
I scrape the fallen leaves aside.
I lower my head to look for leaves again.
My breathing is slow; my chest rises and falls.
I shift two steps toward the water.

lines.zh: 我停在一片斑驳的光里。
lines.en: I stop in a patch of dappled light.
I raise my head and turn slowly to you.

lines.zh: 你比一棵小树差不多高。
lines.en: You are about the height of a small tree.
I stretch my neck and sniff you.
I tilt my head, as if sizing you up.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，往旁边挪了一点。
lines.en: I lift a foot and step aside a little.
I do not mind you standing there.

lines.zh: 我低头，看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I lower my head to see what you hold.
I file your scent away.
I mean no attack.
I walk slowly off to find leaves.
I turn back to look at you.
I stand at your side with my head low.
I give half a step and draw my neck in.
I raise a foot to guard my belly.

lines.zh: 两条长腿撑住才没倒下。
lines.en: My two long legs lock to keep me upright.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙深处哼了一声。
lines.en: I grunt from deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子去够那道伤。
lines.en: I stretch my neck around to reach the wound.
I shift onto another leg to hold myself up.
I walk slowly off a little.
My tail sweeps through the low grass behind me.
I press close to a tree.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼里没有退意。
lines.en: I raise my head, with no thought of backing off.
This thing chews well enough.
I lower my head and take it slowly.
Two chews, then I look at you again.

lines.zh: 再给我一点，我还没嚼够。
lines.en: A little more; I'm not done chewing.
I stretch my neck toward it.
I bring my head level with yours.
Finished, I lick my lips.
I keep searching beside you.

lines.zh: 你掌心里还留着那股味。
lines.en: That smell still clings to your palm.
I shift a step closer and lower my head.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我晃了一下身子。
lines.en: You bump me; my body sways.
I lift a forelimb to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴碰到你，扫了一下。
lines.en: My tail catches you in a sweep.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我退了半步。
lines.en: We collide; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我低头看看你碰的地方。
lines.en: I lower my head to the place you touched.
I shift a step to the side.
You stepped on my claw.
There is no anger in me at all.
I keep walking, around you.
I let out a long breath.
Another is feeding at the treeline.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，脖子交错。
lines.en: We stand side by side, necks crossing.

lines.zh: 我把够到的高枝让给它。
lines.en: I let it have the high branch I reached.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，蹭了蹭我的颈。
lines.en: It leans in and rubs my neck.

lines.zh: 我们一起低头啃同一丛。
lines.en: We lower our heads to the same bush.
Its claws are shorter than mine.
We walk one behind the other.
We stop at the water's edge.
It drinks first. I watch.
We part before dark.
I hold it under a foreclaw.
I take it and chew.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰，不感兴趣。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose, uninterested.
It is not a leaf.
I toss it aside.

lines.zh: 我含着它走到树边才放下。
lines.en: I carry it to the tree before letting it drop.
It is hard in my mouth.
I shove it into the water with my nose.
I study it for a good while.
I release it and walk on.
I stop and turn.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子沉到你胸口高度。
lines.en: My long neck sinks to the height of your chest.

lines.zh: 我前肢一沉，准备压过去。
lines.en: My forelimb sinks, ready to press down.
I lift a long leg and set it toward you.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地面我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the ground under you.
I make a low sound.
I step toward you.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我的爪子就跟上。
lines.en: One step from you and my claw follows.
I know this forest better than you.
Three claws dig into the ground.
I am closer now.

lines.zh: 我的步子一下变得很急。
lines.en: My stride turns suddenly urgent.
I lower my head and extend my neck.
This grove is mine.
I follow you through the trees.

lines.zh: 你转到树后，我横跨过来。
lines.en: You slip behind the tree; I step across.
My stride is long; I catch up fast.

lines.zh: 你砍下来，只划破一点皮。
lines.en: You cut me and only break the skin.
I drive you into the clearing.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，踩断了一根枯枝。
lines.en: I step and snap a dry branch.
I make no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我把这段距离一点点吃掉。
lines.en: I eat up the distance piece by piece.
You can hear my steps.
I lower my head, my beak toward you.

lines.zh: 你退到溪边，那里没有路。
lines.en: You back to the stream. No path there.
I speed up a little.
I lift a claw and sweep the brush aside.
The faster you pant, the slower I go.
I am nearly within reach.
I raise a forelimb and bring it down.
My claws rake your back.
I strike you with my long neck.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，地面凹了。
lines.en: I stomp; the ground dents.
That one misses.
I peck your shoulder.
I shove you against a trunk.
You stop the claw, not the beak.
I pull back half a step and raise a foot.

lines.zh: 这一下把你顶出好几步。
lines.en: That shove sends you back several steps.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，扫断了一丛灌木。
lines.en: I lash my tail and snap a bush.
I lower my head and butt you.

lines.zh: 这一脚把你的盾踹歪了。
lines.en: This kick knocks your shield askew.
I snatch a breath and come on.

lines.zh: 高处的枝叶先被我顶开。
lines.en: The high branches part before me.
I stretch my neck and look around first.

lines.zh: 枯枝在我脚下咔嚓断了。
lines.en: A dead branch snaps under my foot.
There are plenty of leaves here.
I walk to the nearest tree.
I raise a forelimb to a high branch.
I curl a leaf into my mouth.
I shake the soil off my legs.
I move slowly toward the water sound.
I have found a good spot.
I follow the damp earth by scent.
I begin to feed slowly.
I raise my head toward the sound.
I come this way, crackling through the leaves.
I settle in the tree shade.
I start deeper into the grove.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我退进林里。
lines.en: Fire sears my leg; I retreat into the trees.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下，长腿先折。
lines.en: I fall down a slope, long legs first.

lines.zh: 水没到我的脖子，我踩不到底。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck; my feet find no bottom.

lines.zh: 我被气浪推得撞上树干。
lines.en: The blast throws me against a trunk.
An arrow buries in my flank.

lines.zh: 那光像虫一样钻进我骨头。
lines.en: That light crawls into my bones like insects.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到叶子，腿发软。
lines.en: Too long without leaves and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我跳了起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I rear up.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有落脚的树根。
lines.en: No roots to stand on in the dark.
